snippet.title: Dungeons & Desserts - Official Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dungeons & Desserts - Official Demo Announcement Trailer

Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also manage a pastry shop. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell in your cosy bakery, all while balancing the pressures of a greedy landlord constantly increasing your rent.

GENRE: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation
DEVELOPER: Top Chop Games
PUBLISHER: Top Chop Games
RELEASE DATE: To be announced
Steam Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996900/Dungeons__Desserts/
Website : https://dungeonsdesserts.com/
